summary: Iteration 3: monetization system E2E verified. All 16 backend tests pass (10 new + 6 regression). All frontend flows pass: /premium page with plan-free/plan-premium cards and R$ price, subscribe -> checkout-note; UsageBadge on Home for free user navigating to /premium; ad-banner-placeholder shown for free user and hidden for premium (Home + tool page); limit-reached-modal appears with limit-upgrade-button when free_daily_limit=0; Profile shows plan-tag-premium & premium-card-active after upgrade; regression QR preview + history intact.
critical_code_review_comments: isPremium()/getUser() read from localStorage synchronously inside render; a plan change requires a full reload for AdBanner to disappear in another tab. useUsage in AdBanner would be more reactive.
useUsage refresh is not called on window focus or route change; usage badge on Home may stall until user reloads.
/api/checkout/premium is documented as intentionally not configured (returns 200 with configured:false). Consider clearer status code convention if a real gateway is later attached.
Rate-limit error message on /api/generate for premium user hitting cap says 'Limite diário atingido' — fine, but consider adding a separate premium upgrade hint or contact-support message.
test_credentials: admin@facilita.ai / Facilita@123 (per /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Ephemeral test users registered via API during tests.
seed_data_creation: Created transient test users (test_mon_*, test_rl_*, uitest_*) via /api/auth/register. free_daily_limit was toggled to 3/1/0 during tests and restored to 10 at the end (verified via /api/settings). Admin user was NOT modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Monetization endpoints & UI fully validated. Rate limit path: set free_daily_limit=0 via PUT /api/admin/settings then any AI tool returns 402 -> UI shows [data-testid=limit-reached-modal]. Premium bypass path: POST /api/admin/users/{id}/subscription with {plan:premium} then re-login user to refresh localStorage user object. Non-AI tools (password_gen, percentage_calc, qrcode) are NOT rate limited. Google OAuth still an intentional mock. Test users accumulate in DB — cleanup optional.
